rollups.text: Birdwatching equipment, outings, and learning interests: the user got into birdwatching after buying Zeiss Terra ED 8x42 binoculars around 2023-02 (T218); invested in a portable hide around 2023-04, which helped them approach birds without scaring them, and experimented with spotting scopes and tripods (T224). On 2023-03-12, the user saw 15 species at a nearby park, including American Robins, sparrows, and finches, and planned to upload photos to eBird (T361, T363). The user sought apps for tracking sightings and identifying uncertain species, resources for identifying bird calls, and regional field-guide recommendations; no region was specified (T218, T220, T222, T226).

Music interests and instruments: the user recently mastered the F chord on guitar and finds that chord easier to play on ukulele (sources not specified). They are interested in guitar and ukulele solos or riffs by Eric Clapton, Jimmy Page, and Stevie Ray Vaughan (sources not specified). After trying harmonica at a music workshop on 2023-05-25, the user was surprised by how much they enjoyed it and liked its portability and apparent ease of learning; they considered buying a harmonica as well as a ukulele in the following months (T285, T287, T289).

Sculpting and sculpture materials: by 2023-05-25, the user had taken Saturday sculpting classes for about six weeks and was enjoying a plaster human bust project (T293, T295, T299). In their free time, they experimented with polymer clay and resin and made a small mushroom sculpture from a mixture of the two (T295). For the bust's hair, they chose to try cotton fibers, which they had used before and liked for their soft, wispy look (T297, T299). They were also considering an eco-friendly sculpture for a local art competition and liked natural fibers, repurposed paper, bamboo, and rattan (T291, T293, T301).

They wanted to try Kimchi Pad Thai and asked about using tamarind in Thai-Korean bulgogi shrimp tacos (T128, T130). They were also curious about seaweed kimchi and open to experimenting with habanero, ghost pepper, and Szechuan peppercorns in kimchi (T134, T136). For a planned holiday dinner, they chose baked, lower-oil Hanukkah latkes topped with caramelized onions and sour cream, with braised red cabbage on the side (T21, T25, T26, T31). They were interested in a slow-cooker quinoa and lentil curry using carrots nearing expiration and planned to batch and portion it for the week (T182, T186, T188, T190).

After attending an amazing Paul McCartney concert with their parents, they planned to include Beatles and Motown classics and McCartney's “Maybe I'm Amazed” and “Band on the Run”; their parents enjoyed the concert (T33, T37, T39, T43). They also considered George Harrison's “Got My Mind Set on You” and Ringo Starr's “Private Property,” and expressed interest in 1990s alternative, grunge, pop, and hip-hop/R&B, asking for essential tracks (T43, T44).

Pandas learning plan: the user took a free online Python data-analysis lecture around April 2023, which introduced data visualization and pandas; they completed the first two weeks of assignments and quizzes but not the full course (source not specified). On 2023-05-25, they chose to review and refine pandas skills first (source not specified), and planned to practice groupby and aggregation with LeetCode's “Groupby and Aggregate” exercise (T255, T257, T259). They had some prior groupby experience and asked about real-world applications such as customer segmentation and sales analysis (T255, T256).

Around the same date, the fixed showerhead began having noticeably weaker water pressure, which persisted for about three weeks by 2023-05-25; the user considered replacing it and wanted strong pressure but was open to a water-saving model and some pressure compromise (T420, T422, T424, T426, T428). The user had recently cleaned the bathroom mirror and sink and repaired the toilet handle (T422). On 2023-05-25, they were trying to establish a better cleaning routine, had been using Lysol on the floor, and were open to another toilet cleaner (T327, T329, T331). The bathroom cabinet had been reorganized around 2023-04-25, with expired items discarded, and the user later said this had helped substantially (T333, T335).

Family-photo digitization project: the user is organizing a project to digitize old family photos and considered asking cousins to contribute their collections (sources not specified). The user decided to create both a private Facebook group for sharing and discussion and a shared Google Drive folder as the central repository, and planned a contribution guide and a designated person to help upload and organize photos (source not specified). The user planned to ask their aunt, who is good at event planning, to help organize the 2024 family reunion talent show and spread the word about the photo project; cousin Rachel, who is interested in photography, was a possible helper for photographing old pictures at high quality (T307, T311, T313).

The user described a previous Easter family visit on which they packed 10 shirts, 7 pairs of pants, 5 dresses, and 4 pairs of shoes, but wore only 3 shirts, 4 pairs of pants, 2 dresses, and 2 pairs of shoes. They concluded that they had overpacked and agreed to pack fewer clothes for a planned three-day city trip; they also liked the 2-1-1 shoe-packing rule. The exact date of the Easter trip was not given (T158, T162, T163, T164, T165, T166).
